## Ribeirão Preto: Agribusiness, Agrishow and Cultural Heritage

**Ribeirão Preto is one of the Brazilian cities that particularly appeal to travelers with a professional purpose.** It lies in the interior of São Paulo state, in a developed agricultural region. The city hosts Agrishow, an exhibition devoted to agricultural machinery, technological solutions and innovation.

This destination suits delegations, representatives of agribusiness groups, equipment manufacturers and entrepreneurs seeking to learn about Brazilian agriculture. The city also has its own history and cultural life, so a business day can include a walk and a visit to the theatre.

## Agrishow: What Professional Visitors Come to See

The organizers present Agrishow as a major platform for agricultural machinery and technology. Its themes include precision farming, mechanization, crop storage and solutions for farms of different sizes. The exact exhibitors and program change every year.

The official website announces **Agrishow 2027 for April 26–30, 2027**. These are the dates of the event, not automatically confirmed dates for an Ada Tours itinerary. For business travel, registration, transport, an interpreter if needed, meetings with companies of interest and accommodation must be arranged separately.

| Purpose of trip | What to arrange in advance |
|---|---|
| Exhibition visit | Ticket and visit schedule |
| Business negotiations | Company list and meetings |
| Technology research | Thematic exhibition halls |
| Exploring the region | Excursions and logistics |

Admission to the exhibition does not in itself provide access to restricted production facilities, individual machinery demonstrations or meetings with company executives. These activities require separate arrangements.

## How the Agricultural Interior Differs from the Tourist Coast

The Ribeirão Preto region is associated with sugarcane cultivation and the production of sugar and ethanol. It provides a perspective on Brazil's industrial and agricultural economy quite different from beach-oriented [Rio de Janeiro](/brazil/place/rio-de-janeiro/) or the natural landscapes of the [Pantanal](/brazil/place/pantanal/).

Agronomists, engineers and investors may have very specific aims: studying equipment, farm management, supply chains or the processing of agricultural raw materials. **The city name alone does not confirm a visit to a factory or field**, so each professional site must be explicitly listed in the itinerary.

When group members have different backgrounds, it is useful to separate business meetings from general sightseeing. Two intensive days at an exhibition plus a day exploring the city require different arrangements from an ordinary leisure tour.

## The Pedro II Theatre and Quarteirão Paulista

**Theatro Pedro II**, which opened in 1930, stands in the city center. Municipal sources associate it with the Quarteirão Paulista architectural ensemble, developed with the involvement of Companhia Cervejaria Paulista, a brewing company. This area reveals the region's architectural history during the first half of the twentieth century.

If you have a free evening, check the theatre's program or simply stroll around the historic center. The theatre remains an active cultural venue; entry and the chance to attend a performance depend on its schedule, not merely on its appearance in a sightseeing description.

For comparison, [São Paulo](/brazil/place/sao-paulo/) offers a far wider range of major museums and urban infrastructure, while Ribeirão Preto provides a specialized business purpose and a regional perspective.

## How Ada Tours Includes Ribeirão Preto in an Itinerary

We offer the [tour "Agribusiness in Brazil: Ribeirão Preto, the Amazon, Rio and Iguazu"](/brazil/tour/brazil-agribusiness-14-days/). It combines a professional theme with travel through other regions. The Amazon and Iguazu in the title show the itinerary's geographical range, but **details of exhibition participation and all included services must be checked in the program itself**.

If Agrishow is the focus, first choose the exhibition dates and number of professional days, then add [Rio de Janeiro](/brazil/place/rio-de-janeiro/), Iguazu or other destinations. Reversing that order could leave too little time for negotiations.

When organizing a group, consider the difference between a tourist guide and a specialist business interpreter, ticket requirements, road schedules and travel time to the airport. None of these services can be assumed simply because a trip is described as a "business tour."

## Frequently Asked Questions About Ribeirão Preto

### When does Agrishow take place?

According to the organizers' official website, the next exhibition is scheduled for April 26–30, 2027. Check the dates and registration requirements before purchasing your trip.

### Is Ribeirão Preto suitable for leisure travelers?

Yes. There is a historic center and a theatre to explore, although Ada Tours itineraries featuring the city primarily focus on agribusiness and professional activities.

### Is an Agrishow ticket included in every tour visiting the city?

No. Mentioning the exhibition in the destination description does not confirm that admission is included. Check the terms of the specific itinerary.

## Tours Visiting Ribeirão Preto: Business Travel and Exploring Brazil

**Agribusiness is the main reason to include Ribeirão Preto in your itinerary.** The city lies in the interior of São Paulo state, in a region producing sugarcane, sugar and ethanol. It is a convenient place to explore agricultural machinery, industry technologies and business connections before continuing to other parts of Brazil.

Our catalog includes {{catalog.toursCountPhrase}} with the city as a required stop: the [14-day "Agribusiness in Brazil" itinerary](/brazil/tour/brazil-agribusiness-14-days/). It combines a business stage with [São Paulo](/brazil/place/sao-paulo/), the Amazon, [Rio de Janeiro](/brazil/place/rio-de-janeiro/) and Iguazu Falls. Distinguishing business days from sightseeing days matters: events in Ribeirão Preto require separate confirmation.

## What Is Planned in Ribeirão Preto?

Our itinerary allocates **two business days** to the city, preceded by a road journey from São Paulo. The first day addresses trends in the agricultural industry, food production technologies, sustainable development and professional exchange. The second covers agricultural technologies, sustainable practices and biotechnology.

These are the themes of the professional stage, not a promise of admission to a particular conference or company. The organizer, venue, presentation schedule, participation of company representatives and registration fees must be agreed before booking. An exhibition and an industry meeting are not interchangeable: they have different purposes, schedules and admission terms.

| Stage | Purpose |
|---|---|
| São Paulo | Arrival and discovering the city |
| Ribeirão Preto | Two days devoted to agribusiness |
| Amazon | Lodge, rivers and rainforest |
| Rio de Janeiro | City, Corcovado, Sugarloaf Mountain |
| Iguazu | Waterfalls on both sides of the border |

This type of itinerary suits travelers who want both professional meetings and an introduction to Brazil. For an exclusively business-oriented visit tied to an exhibition date, it makes more sense to discuss the length of the Ribeirão Preto stay and whether the other regions are needed.

## Agrishow and Other Events: What Is Actually Confirmed?

**Agrishow 2027 is scheduled in Ribeirão Preto for April 26–30, 2027.** These dates were published by the organizer of Brazil's major agricultural technology exhibition. Exhibitors include machinery and equipment manufacturers and providers of solutions for precision farming, storage, irrigation and other agricultural activities.

However, the [Ada Tours itinerary visiting Ribeirão Preto](/brazil/tour/brazil-agribusiness-14-days/) **is not sold as a confirmed Agrishow 2027 package**. Its description does not specify fixed exhibition dates, a registration ticket or an agreed schedule of meetings at the event. To attend Agrishow, the tour dates must be aligned with the exhibition and the included services confirmed separately.

Agrishow should not be confused with IFAMA. The current tour description specifically notes that the IFAMA 2027 conference will take place in Lima, Peru, and participation in that conference in Ribeirão Preto is not included. If a particular international congress is your goal, establish its venue and dates before selecting a route.

## Can You Combine Business Travel with a Cultural Program?

Yes. In your free time, explore the historic center of [Ribeirão Preto](/brazil/place/ribeirao-preto/). One landmark is the Pedro II Theatre, opened in 1930. It is part of the Quarteirão Paulista ensemble, near squares and historic urban buildings. Interior tours and performances depend on the current schedule, so they are possible leisure activities rather than automatically included elements of the business tour.

During the journey from [São Paulo](/brazil/place/sao-paulo/), professional activities can be combined with city sightseeing. The itinerary includes an introduction to São Paulo's historic and modern districts before departure for Ribeirão Preto.

The trip then changes character dramatically. The Amazon stage includes lodge accommodation and nature excursions; Rio offers urban sightseeing; at [Iguazu](/brazil/place/foz-do-iguacu/) there are panoramic viewpoints and a visit to the Argentine side. This shift from business meetings to nature and culture distinguishes the itinerary from a conventional exhibition visit.

## Choosing Dates and Assessing the Itinerary

First decide whether attending a particular exhibition is essential or whether a professional program focused on agribusiness topics would meet your needs. These are two different starting points.

**For an industry event**, check its official dates, opening hours, ticket requirements and group size limits. For major events, hotels and ground transportation should be arranged early. Travel time from São Paulo and back to the airport needs to be counted separately from working days.

**For a combined journey**, consider the entire itinerary. The 14-day program includes 13 nights, several regions and domestic flights. Its published conditions list accommodation, transfers and some guided excursions as included; international and domestic flights, insurance and certain extra expenses are outside the base package. Pricing is calculated individually because business arrangements and dates require agreement.

It helps to list required meeting participants, companies or industry topics of interest, the language of business communication and days reserved for leisure. That information will make your inquiry specific without assuming that exhibition tickets or factory visits are included in every trip to this agricultural city.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### How many Ada Tours trips visit Ribeirão Preto?

The current number is displayed in the catalog: {{catalog.toursCountPhrase}}. The available itinerary combines agribusiness with the Amazon, Rio and Iguazu; the precise business event dates are arranged separately.

### Is Agrishow 2027 included in the tour price?

There is no confirmation that Agrishow tickets, registration or attendance are included in the published itinerary. The exhibition dates are known, but participation and the details of the business program must be established when booking.

### How does a business program differ from a sightseeing excursion?

A business day focuses on professional meetings or industry events; a city excursion introduces visitors to architecture, history and local life. The Ada Tours itinerary allocates different stages to these activities.

### Can I visit Ribeirão Preto without the other regions?

That would be a separate request to modify the itinerary. The tour shown lasts 14 days and visits several regions of Brazil; a shorter business trip requires new arrangements for dates and services.

lead: >-
  The Claro River near the Jardim da Amazônia lodge in Mato Grosso is a place for peaceful canoe trips along forested banks. Canoes head from the lodge toward Anaconda Lake, with opportunities to watch birds along the way. It is important to distinguish this river from the many other places called Rio Claro in Brazil and to clarify water conditions, guiding and excursion inclusions in advance.
---

## The Claro River near Jardim da Amazônia: Canoeing on the Southern Edge of the Amazon

**The Rio Claro near the Jardim da Amazônia lodge is a natural attraction best experienced from the water.** A short canoe outing offers views of riverside trees, reflections of the forest and birdlife. This is a very different way to discover the region from a long road trip or a general city sightseeing tour.

This is a specific river in the São José do Rio Claro area of Mato Grosso state. Rio Claro is a common name in Brazil, so this location must not be confused with the [Rio Claro valley near Chapada dos Guimarães](/brazil/place/chapada-dos-guimaraes-national-park/). The local lodge and the route's geography are crucial when choosing the right excursion.

## What Happens on a Canoe Trip?

Our canoe route starts near the **Jardim da Amazônia** lodge and heads toward Anaconda Lake. Travelers observe forested riverbanks and watch birds along the way. The itinerary includes other outings around the lodge, but the exact activities for each day should be read separately.

A canoe moves slowly enough to hear the forest and notice subtle movement in the trees. This kind of wildlife watching takes patience. What you encounter depends on the time of day, water level and season.

Possible sightings along the river include kingfishers, herons, cormorants and tanagers. These are potential sightings, not species guaranteed on any outing. Consider in advance whether your aim is bird photography or simply spending time on a river surrounded by nature.

## Amazonian Forest and the Transitional Landscapes of Mato Grosso

The southern edge of the Amazonian forest differs from major river expeditions on the Rio Negro. Here, one journey can combine forest areas with other Mato Grosso landscapes. It is a chance to see different facets of Brazil's natural world without spending every day in the same region.

The ["Three Ecosystems in 8 Days" tour](/brazil/tour/brazil-three-ecosystems-8-days/) combines Jardim da Amazônia and the Claro River with savannas and the [Pantanal](/brazil/place/pantanal/). It is a purposeful contrast: birdwatching on a quiet forest river differs from excursions along the [Transpantaneira](/brazil/place/transpantaneira/) and observing larger aquatic animals.

| Area | Main activity |
|---|---|
| Claro River | Canoeing and forested banks |
| Jardim da Amazônia lodge | Nature walks |
| Chapada dos Guimarães | Cliffs, savanna and waterfalls |
| Pantanal | Plains and photographic safaris |

You should not expect the same animals across all these ecosystems. Landscapes, viewing times and guiding arrangements vary.

## Anaconda Lake: What Does the Name Mean?

"Anaconda Lake" appears in the itinerary near the Claro River, but **its name does not guarantee an encounter with a snake**. It is a geographical point on the route, not an attraction where animals appear on a schedule. On nature tours, it is important to distinguish a place name from the actual likelihood of seeing a particular species.

While canoeing, keep quiet and follow your guide's instructions. Do not feed animals, approach nests or damage riverside vegetation. Even calm river waters require appropriate life-saving equipment and attention to weather conditions.

## Preparing for a River Excursion

Ask what type of canoe is used, how many people it carries, whether life jackets are provided and who accompanies participants. Water and weather conditions can change the route, so a program that permits a safe change of departure time is preferable.

Lightweight clothing with some coverage, a hat, sun and insect protection, a dry case for your camera and binoculars are useful on the boat. If you want good bird photographs, discuss the excursion's timing and the length of observation stops in advance.

The river is a natural attraction, not a hotel product in its own right. Meals, lodge accommodation, transfers and additional trails **must be checked against the specific itinerary**.

## How Does This Route Compare with Other Parts of Brazil?

If your main goal is seeing large wildlife on wetland plains, the [Pantanal](/brazil/place/pantanal/) may be a priority. If you prefer caves and clear rivers, consider [Bonito](/brazil/place/bonito/). For a gentle forest canoe trip, the Claro River near Jardim da Amazônia is an excellent fit.

We describe the Claro River separately to explain its place within the itinerary. This helps clarify what is included in the [eight-day journey through three ecosystems](/brazil/tour/brazil-three-ecosystems-8-days/), but it is not a comprehensive list of every possible regional excursion.

## Frequently Asked Questions About the Claro River

### Is this the same river as the one near Chapada dos Guimarães?

No. This page describes the Rio Claro near the Jardim da Amazônia lodge in the São José do Rio Claro area of Mato Grosso.

### Are we guaranteed to see an anaconda at the lake?

No. The lake's name does not promise a sighting. Wildlife observations depend on natural conditions.

### Is this a separate multi-day tour?

The Claro River is part of our [three-ecosystem itinerary](/brazil/tour/brazil-three-ecosystems-8-days/). The duration and cost of a standalone river outing depend on the specific offer.

## Tours to the Claro River near the Jardim da Amazônia Lodge

**The Claro River is best for observing nature from the water.** Green riverbanks come close to the water here, and a canoe provides views of trees, riverside vegetation and birds. This stretch lies in the São José do Rio Claro area of Mato Grosso state, near the [Jardim da Amazônia lodge](/brazil/place/jardim-da-amazonia/). The surrounding landscape is a transition between the Amazon forest and Cerrado savanna.

Our selection includes {{catalog.toursCountPhrase}} with a required visit to this stretch of river. The ["Amazon, Savanna and Pantanal: Three Ecosystems in 8 Days" itinerary](/brazil/tour/brazil-three-ecosystems-8-days/) begins in Cuiabá, includes two nights near the Claro River and then travels through Bom Jardim and Chapada dos Guimarães to the Northern Pantanal. It offers a way to experience contrasting natural regions of Mato Grosso on one journey, rather than a short visit to just any Brazilian river called Rio Claro.

## A Day on the Claro River

On the second day of the eight-day program, travelers head out on forest trails near the lodge after breakfast. The guide explains local vegetation and the history of rubber extraction. The separate ["Forest Trails and Canoeing" excursion](/brazil/jardim-da-amazonia/jardim-amazonia-forest-canoe/) includes a fish barbecue and a rest in a hammock.

The water-based part takes place **by canoe along the Claro River toward [Anaconda Lake](/brazil/place/anaconda-lake-jardim-amazonia/)**. This format is ideal for relaxed observation: as you move, you can look for birds along the banks and in the treetops and see reflections of the forest in the water. Possible sightings include kingfishers, herons, cormorants and tanagers. These are examples of birds found in the area, not a list of guaranteed sightings.

The second overnight stay is at the Jardim da Amazônia lodge. Breakfast, lunch and dinner are included on this day. The following day, the itinerary moves on to other natural areas of the state.

### The Claro River, Anaconda Lake and Forest Trails: How Are They Different?

| Place | Main experience |
|---|---|
| Claro River | Canoeing, riverbanks and birds |
| Anaconda Lake | Water-based stage of the route |
| Forest near the lodge | Plants, trails and the guide's explanations |
| Lodge grounds | Rest between excursions |

These stops share a natural environment but offer different vantage points. On the trail, it is easier to study terrestrial plants; from the water, you can see along the banks. Together, they provide a fuller introduction to the area over two days.

## How This Part of the Amazon Differs from the Pantanal

The Claro River near Jardim da Amazônia lies in a forested area of the southern Amazon. Observations here often center on trees, riverbanks and the sounds of the forest. The [Pantanal](/brazil/place/pantanal/) is a different environment, with wetland plains, floodplains, open water and seasonal flooding. Under favorable conditions, animals may be easier to spot in open areas, although sightings are never guaranteed there either.

Between them lies the Cerrado savanna with its own vegetation types. After the Claro River, the eight-day tour visits [Bom Jardim](/brazil/place/bom-jardim/) for snorkeling in clear water and [Chapada dos Guimarães](/brazil/place/chapada-dos-guimaraes-national-park/) for sandstone cliffs, waterfalls and walks. The journey ends in the Northern Pantanal, with nature excursions and a horseback ride.

| Region on the route | Activities |
|---|---|
| Southern Amazon | Forest trails and canoeing |
| Bom Jardim | Clear water and snorkeling |
| Chapada dos Guimarães | Cliffs, views and waterfalls |
| Northern Pantanal | Birds, animals and floodplains |

This distinction matters when selecting a tour. If your aim is extended birdwatching in a single forest region, look for an itinerary that spends more nights at the lodge. If you prefer comparing several ecosystems, the combined journey offers a broader perspective but also involves transfers.

## When to Travel and What to Consider Before Departure

Conditions in the tropical forest depend on rainfall, the state of the trails and river levels. Seasonal patterns in Mato Grosso also affect road access and nature activities. There is no universally best month for visiting the Claro River, Chapada dos Guimarães and the Pantanal together: what matters most is the purpose of your trip and the actual itinerary for your chosen dates.

For canoeing and forest walks, pack comfortable non-slip footwear, light clothes, sun and insect protection, and waterproof protection for your camera. On the water, follow your guide's instructions and wear the safety equipment provided when required. Watching birds is generally easier without loud conversation or sudden movements.

The lodge operator separately offers specialist birdwatching and primate-watching programs. Their availability **does not mean automatic inclusion** in every Ada Tours itinerary. The eight-day tour confirms specific forest and water activities; additional options are discussed separately.

**Planning the logistics matters.** The journey starts in [Cuiabá](/brazil/place/cuiaba/) and includes several ground transfers. The program provides seven nights across three lodges, scheduled transfers, meals as detailed by day, and excursions with an English-speaking guide or naturalist. International and domestic flights are paid for separately. Compare the duration and conditions of the selected tour in its complete program.

## Comparing Nature Journeys via the Claro River

The key difference is the proportion of the journey spent in the forest. **The eight-day itinerary includes two nights at Jardim da Amazônia.** The remaining days focus on the savanna and Pantanal. If your main purpose is to see the Amazon alone, two nights may be a short introduction, especially after allowing for travel in both directions.

Think about what matters most to you: gentle forest walks, photographs of birds, mammal watching or seeing different natural areas. Then compare the actual itinerary days, types of ground transportation, language of guiding and included meals. Do not select a tour solely because it mentions "Amazon": different parts of this enormous region offer very different experiences.

Also note that **the Claro River near Jardim da Amazônia and [Rio da Prata near Bonito](/brazil/place/rio-da-prata/) are distinct places**. The first involves canoeing and observing the forest in the selected tour; Rio da Prata is known for surface snorkeling among freshwater fish. They can be confused when searching simply for a "river" excursion.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### How many Ada Tours itineraries visit the Claro River?

The current number is {{catalog.toursCountPhrase}}. The existing itinerary includes the river in an eight-day journey through the Amazon, Cerrado and Northern Pantanal.

### Is canoeing included in the itinerary?

Yes. Day two includes a water excursion along the Claro River toward Anaconda Lake. Details are provided on the [lodge excursion page](/brazil/jardim-da-amazonia/jardim-amazonia-forest-canoe/).

### Can sightings of specific animals be guaranteed?

No. Kingfishers, herons and other birds are possible sightings, but the presence of any particular species beside the river depends on natural conditions. The forest landscape is itself a rewarding part of the journey.

### How many nights are planned near the river?

The published eight-day tour includes two nights at Jardim da Amazônia. Later nights are spent in other natural areas of Mato Grosso state.

## Rio da Prata: Snorkeling Among Fish in a Crystal-Clear Brazilian River

Rio da Prata is in Mato Grosso do Sul state, near the town of Jardim, not far from [Bonito](/brazil/place/bonito/). People visit for an unusual way to experience freshwater nature: put on a mask, float at the surface and drift slowly with the current while observing the riverbed, plant roots and shoals of fish directly below.

The water is clear enough to reveal both large fish and smaller features of the river landscape. In some stretches you can see a sandy bed; elsewhere, lush underwater vegetation. Instead of swimming hard, participants follow the gentle current. In Brazil this activity is called *flutuação*, or floating: it is **surface snorkeling**, not scuba diving.

## Where Is the Nature Route and How Does It Work?

Although the excursion is often marketed as one of Bonito's main attractions, Recanto Ecológico Rio da Prata itself lies in the municipality of Jardim. The natural complex includes protected forest, the source of the Olho d'Água River and its confluence with Rio da Prata.

The experience generally begins on land. Travelers walk with a guide along a forest trail, where trees, birds and signs of riverside wildlife may be seen. At the Olho d'Água spring, participants receive instructions and learn how to float correctly. The current then gradually carries them through an underwater garden toward the point where the water meets Rio da Prata. This sequence reveals the rivers' life from different perspectives before visitors return to the start of the route.

The natural area is managed as a private protected reserve. Group-size limits and visitor rules help preserve the water's clarity and riverside plants. Visits require an advance reservation for a designated time; procedures and equipment depend on the particular excursion operator.

## What Fish Might You See Underwater?

One of Rio da Prata's recognizable residents is the *piraputanga*, a silvery fish with distinctively colored fins. Pacu, dourado and other freshwater species also inhabit the local waters. Species and the number of sightings vary with conditions, so a precise list cannot be promised in advance.

The underwater plants are every bit as fascinating as the fish. Clear water reveals long green leaves, the current flowing around them and patches of sunlight on the pale riverbed. While floating, there is no need to chase animals or touch plants: simply stay at the surface and look down.

Water clarity is influenced by the local geology, the condition of the riverside forest and rainfall. Following heavy rain, excursion routes may be adjusted for safety. Choose this river for the natural experience itself rather than a promise of unchanging visibility measured in meters.

## Rio da Prata or the Sucuri River: Which to Choose in Bonito?

Both rivers are known for clear water and snorkeling excursions, but they are **different attractions**. The [Sucuri River](/brazil/place/sucuri-river/) lies closer to Bonito; its route combines a walk to the springs with a gentle float downstream. At Rio da Prata, the Olho d'Água spring, a longer river stretch and a fish-rich underwater landscape are important parts of the experience.

Some Bonito itineraries allow visits to both attractions on different days. If you only have time for one excursion, consider travel time, the format of the route and which natural environment interests you most. Both are for observing nature, not sport diving.

Beyond the rivers, the area also offers [Bonito's Blue Lake Cave](/brazil/place/blue-lake-cave-bonito/), where the focus shifts to a limestone cave and a lake with intensely blue water. Combining these places reveals the region's nature above and below the water.

## Rio da Prata in Ada Tours Itineraries

On the ["Amazing Brazil" itinerary](/brazil/tour/amazing-brazil/), the Bonito stage includes the Blue Lake Cave followed by water-based activities at Rio da Prata. The program covers the forest trail, Olho d'Água spring and snorkeling among fish.

The ["Brazil Tour to Iguazu Falls with a Beach Holiday in Búzios"](/brazil/tour/brazil-iguazu-buzios-13-days/) sets aside a separate day for snorkeling at Rio da Prata. The excursion begins at the natural complex and then follows the water route; other Bonito activities take place at their own sites and do not turn Rio da Prata into a rafting river.

Both tours combine clear rivers with other regions of Brazil. When choosing a journey, compare not only the names of attractions but also the number of days in Bonito, the order of transfers and the excursions actually included.

## Frequently Asked Questions About Rio da Prata

### Is Rio da Prata in Bonito?

The tourist route lies in the Jardim area of Mato Grosso do Sul state. Bonito is a convenient base for visits to this and other natural attractions.

### Do I need scuba gear to swim in the river?

No. The regular excursion uses a mask and snorkel, with participants floating at the surface. A guide gives instructions before the water section.

### How is Olho d'Água different from Rio da Prata?

Olho d'Água is a separate river with a clear spring, and much of the standard route starts there. Farther downstream, it joins Rio da Prata, which is why both names appear in the description of one excursion.

### Can I see fish without a guaranteed visibility of 50 meters?

Yes. The purpose of floating is to observe fish, plants and the river landscape in natural conditions. Visibility varies and is not a fixed guarantee of the tour.
